overview: Pocahontas is a 1995 American animated musical historical drama film loosely based on the life of Powhatan woman Pocahontas and the arrival of English settlers from the Virginia Company. It was directed by Mike Gabriel and Eric Goldberg from a screenplay written by Carl Binder, Susannah Grant and Philip LaZebnik. Produced by Walt Disney Feature Animation, the film romanticizes Pocahontas' encounter with John Smith and her legendary saving of his life.
